result.description: Operator directive (PLAN-PATHNORM-001, decision D1 2026-10-07: delivered in P1). Persisted workspace paths, storage keys and identity hashes use '/' as the separator for all platforms; the windows: (case-insensitive) / case-sensitive: tag is kept; Windows-origin paths are detected by drive letter (C:/) or UNC (//server/share), not by separator; the UNC leading '//' is preserved; paths are converted to '\' only at OS boundaries that require it (\\?\ long-path prefixes, cmd.exe arguments, native APIs). AC1: C:\Users\kingd, C:/Users/kingd and c:/users/KINGD produce one storage key. AC2: \\srv\share\x and //srv/share/x produce one storage key that still starts with //. AC3: Existing stores are converted by the --workspace-path-rekey maintenance command (decisions D5-D7 2026-10-07): after it runs no Windows-shaped workspace value contains a backslash, per-table and per-workspace row counts are unchanged, and foreign keys validate; the server refuses to start against an unconverted store (no dual-key lookup). AC4: Native file operations on Windows receive backslash paths where the OS requires them.
result.title: Persist workspace paths with forward slashes and platform tag
